issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 OO issue requesting BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense status, patient, and identifier search parameters, usageInstruction changed to string, and subject renamed to patient.
initial_application: Commit 7ca454a878, merged by HL7/fhir#2758 as 5ff9d7dca1, applied the patient element/search-parameter rename and added status and identifier search parameters. Follow-on R5 QA commit 902ba6f126 changed usageInstruction from CodeableConcept to string.
additional_context: FHIR-41413 later made a final R6 OO decision to change BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense.patient back to subject with Reference(Patient | Group), add subject search, and retain patient search as subject.where(resolve() is Patient). Commit 3b38b80cf2 then removed several OO resources, including BDPDispense, from active core build lists and pointed module pages to the OO Incubator IG.
